The result determines every fiber and every input-cardinality coefficient, providing a complete classification of possible outputs and sharp universal coefficientwise bounds with a unique extremizer; this closes a clear gap between a special 2026 separated-family count and arbitrary finite targets. No speculative downstream theorem is required.
